---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new operator, optimisation, or improvement to ForgeRT
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A concise description of the feature or improvement.

## Motivation

Why would this be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed approach

How might this be implemented? Even a rough outline helps.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you prefer this one.

## Additional context

Links to papers, related projects, or other context.

---

**Note:** ForgeRT is an educational project. Features that fit the existing
operator set (Add, ReLU, MatMul, Softmax, LayerNorm) and scheduler architecture
are most likely to be considered. Conv2D and transformer attention are explicitly
out of scope for now.
